_note: Map v3 (MAP_README.md): what this baked region holds. Tiles: tiles/<i>_<j>.m3t (map/format/tileFormat.ts, gzipped), tile (i, j) covering x ∈ [i·tileSize, (i+1)·tileSize), z (south) likewise, in the projection below.
name: San Francisco

projection.axes: x east, z south, y up (metres)

osm.note: OpenStreetMap data as published by Overture Maps (its transportation and base themes keep OSM geometry and tags); a Geofabrik extract replaces it when reachable

overture.used: building heights, floors, roof shapes and colours; buildings OSM lacks

elevation.conversion: EPSG:5703 → EGM2008 (EPSG:3855) via PROJ: GEOID18 (us_noaa_g2018u0.tif) + EGM2008 (us_nga_egm08_25.tif)

barriers._note: Railings and walls: how they look (height, thickness, colour) and their collider — always at least minThickness thick and extraHeight taller than what's drawn (1.2 m: even a car launched off a 300 km/h hit can't vault one). auto: railings OSM often lacks (marked estimated).

auto._note: Railings OSM often lacks, added and marked estimated: both sides of bridges, motorway edges and the median between a motorway's carriageways, and road edges where the ground drops more than drop m within reach m (for at least minRun m), away from junctions.
